Hi all —

Quick sync: SterlingTech's renewal is 2028-09-14 and Finance asked for a final evidence bundle and a short risk note by Aug 1 so they can include the ARR in next quarter close. I want to run a short ops sprint to confirm stage validity, collect missing evidence, and assign owners for any outstanding items.

- Ben: verify usage evidence (token/embedding consumption) for last 12 months and attach the summary PDF.
- Marcus: confirm legal/IP/contract exceptions and whether they requested any SLA concessions during the pilot.
- Laura: validate billing status and confirm there are no invoice disputes that would block renewal.
- Beth / Sterling procurement: can you confirm a PO timeline or any internal gating items? If you prefer, we can accept a conditional PO and finalize terms post-signature.

I've created a Drive folder (link below) and stubbed an evidence checklist. Please drop items there and reply here with any blockers. We'll do a 20-minute call Monday 8/1 10:00am PT if helpful.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/sterling/renewal-evidence

Thanks — short and practical. If anyone can't make the Monday call, leave a one-line update here.
